Intentional CAN contact during grasping receives no exemption in Jr_soft. The CAN remains an observed object box; tool-envelope overlap or negative clearance contributes the maximum soft deficit. This is a ranking cost only: hard contact/grasp policy and safety vetoes are unchanged.

Ju measures predicted command-following consistency, not calibrated uncertainty.

decision_time_amendment.unchanged: Jg and Jl definitions and implementations are unchanged.
decision_time_amendment.jr: Hard safety veto remains separate and precedent. Jr_soft is an uncertified tool-envelope segment/AABB clearance proxy, not certified full-arm clearance.
decision_time_amendment.ju: Ju_consistency is a deterministic command-following residual from current observation, candidate chunk and predicted trajectory; no future observed state or calibrated uncertainty is claimed.
decision_time_amendment.activation: No binding, weight, threshold or scored evaluation is activated by this proposal.

clarifications.jr_can_contact: No silent exemption. The CAN stays in the observed object set for Jr_soft; intentional contact during grasping yields negative tool-envelope clearance and the maximum soft deficit. Hard contact/grasp policy and vetoes are unchanged.
clarifications.ju_alignment: Strict len(actions)+1 action-to-prediction alignment, current/predicted object identity match, sorted JointTarget joint ordering, explicit gripper accounting for EEDelta/EEPoseTarget/GripperCmd, and MissingObjectiveInput on empty or unsupported comparisons. Ju measures predicted command-following consistency, not calibrated uncertainty.

calibration_evaluator.contract: Callable[[Mapping[str, Any], CalibrationEvidence], float] injected through an explicit owner-reviewed binding; no dynamic config imports; not registered in production until owner approval
inputs: one reviewable stage-3 draft with >=1 candidate parameter set (weights + maximize) and all four explicit component bindings
one hash-pinned, owner-approved VALIDATION-only evidence artifact: schema_version=1, split=validation, approved=true, 18 unique episode_ids, explicit source_hashes, measurement_class
an evaluator callable registered under registered_calibration_evaluator_v1
outputs: one finite scalar score per candidate
recommended_candidate_id and recommended_parameters under registered_evaluator_max_score_then_candidate_id (max score, then candidate_id tie-break)
a CalibrationProposal explicitly labelled selection_statistic_not_independent_evaluation with provenance recording independent_evaluation=false
calibration_evaluator.evidence: the frozen 18-episode VALIDATION outcomes referenced by the evidence artifact; collection and approval are separate decisions, and the proposal never writes or approves parameters
calibration_evaluator.fail_closed: rejects unapproved evidence, tampered source hashes, TEST/TRAIN paths, non-finite scores, unpermitted parameter keys, empty candidate grids and any missing binding
calibration_evaluator.prohibition: the selection statistic is not an independent estimate of post-calibration performance and does not fix the numeric weights; weights and ranking direction stay VALIDATION-selected and owner-approved
